calls.title: Hack Week Demos Part 2
calls.summary: The meeting highlighted several advancements in GrowthBook's capabilities, including a demonstration of a new integration for automating experiment creation, feature flag deployment, and analysis within Claude Desktop, which significantly reduces QA steps and allows for faster iterations. The introduction of the Open Experiment Standard (OES) aims to facilitate experiment portability across platforms using a universal JSON format. A new Slack bot was presented to improve enterprise customer support by automating query classification and PR creation while retaining human approval for accuracy. Additionally, a copy-paste feature for feature flags was proposed to streamline management between development and production environments. Enhancements to the super admin dashboard, real-time error tracking, and session replay features were also discussed to further improve organizational efficiency and product health.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Experimentation, AI Skills, Open Experiment Standards, Slack Triage Bot, Session Replay
calls.action_items:

Deploy the AI-powered Slack triage bot to enterprise customer support channels with a human approval gate to maintain service quality (38:54)
Enhance Slack bot messaging capabilities with possible automated responses, respecting customer consent settings (38:54)

Push the GrowthBook error tracking plugin into production behind a feature flag and compare error fingerprinting accuracy against Sentry (01:27:04)
Address session replay SDK performance concerns and backend bottlenecks; explore session filtering on flags or experiment variants and AI-assisted session analysis (01:45:52)

**GrowthBook Team**

Investigate the feasibility and impact of integrating mobile session replay capabilities (01:59:56)
